uses.quote: Be critical of the output, ensuring it’s reputable, accurate and current.
Do not simply copy and paste the Gen-AI output into ANY assessment submission and hope for the best.
All AI tools and platforms are strictly prohibited.
Examples: Invigilated exams and oral tests.
In AI-supported assessments, students use unsupervised AI tools.

decided_by.quote: The Bond University AI Assessment Framework establishes clear categories for integrating AI into academic assessments, ensuring academic integrity, assurance of learning, and the development of digital literacy among students.
Subject outlines and iLearn sites will indicate which category applies to an assessment item.
Staff must clearly communicate AI usage guidelines, and students need to follow these instructions carefully.
